messages.subject: Legend and colour issues
parts:
Hi everyone,

I have some issues with ggplot ...

Here is my code :

####Decembre
p <- ggplot(dec, aes(dayindec, LT))
p + geom_point(aes(colour = factor(yearindec), size=2))+ stat_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) + ylab("Total Lenght") + xlab("Days") + ggtitle(bquote(atop(.("December")))) + theme_bw() + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,31,by=5)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(42,56,by=2)) + theme(legend.title=element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold"), panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom")

####Janvier
p2 <- ggplot(jan, aes(dayinjan, LT))
p2 + geom_point(aes(colour = factor(yearinjan), size=2)+ stat_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE) + ylab("Total Lenght") + xlab("Days") + ggtitle(bquote(atop(.("January")))) + theme_bw() + scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,31,by=5)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(42,56,by=2)) +theme(legend.title=element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold"), panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom")

You can find figures attached.

First problem, I want my dots size = 2 . But I don't want this information appears in the legend, like this code does. How can I do ?

Second one, because yearindec=4 and yearinjan=3, colours are not the same for the same year in both of my graphs. I want to standardize that (same colour for same year, even if a year is missing in one graph). How can I do ?

Third one, colours are currently random. How can I choose them ? For exemple scale of blue.

Waiting for news from you
Thank you !

messages.subject: Re: Legend and colour issues
parts:
Julien, 

I'm sorry, but that's not reproducible. 

your data is called data8, but you're referencing data2. Then your doing manipulations outside of your dataframe and using those as variables in your plot (which I'm surprised works at all without using qplot). Then your manipulations cause the LT variable to be all NAs, which plots nothing (see warning below). Lastly, your dates are all 2020 and your scale is using 2009-2014. 

Warning messages:
1: In loop_apply(n, do.ply) :
  Removed 2013 rows containing missing values (stat_smooth).
2: In loop_apply(n, do.ply) :
  Removed 2013 rows containing missing values (geom_point).

Could you try again?

parts:
Julien, 

The first answer is still you have to take the size=2 out of aes() and it looks like you figured out the scale color pretty well, but your gray scale is hard to decipher. 

ggplot(dec, aes(dayindec, LT)) +
geom_point(aes(colour = factor(yearindec)), size=2) +

scale_colour_manual(values = c("2009" = "grey1","2010" = "grey25","2013" = "grey50", "2014"="grey75")) +
stat_smooth(method="lm", se=FALSE, size=1, colour="black") +
ylab("Total Length") +

xlab("Days") +
ggtitle(bquote(atop(.("December")))) +
theme_bw() +
scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(1,31,by=5)) +
scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(42,56,by=2)) +
theme(legend.title=element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(lineheight=.8, face="bold"), panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), legend.position="bottom")

HTH
B
